sources.title: Hy-MT2-1.8B model card, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Names Hy-MT2-1.8B within the Hy-MT2 translation family, reports the nominal 1.8B scale and translation among 33 languages, and explicitly says the exact model was open-sourced on 2026-05-21. Fresh October 27 re-read of current main matches the pinned card and still explicitly lists this variant as the Hy 1.8B translation model; it does not separately state active parameters.

sources.title: Hy-MT2 official deployment README
sources.evidence: Lists this exact model, explicitly sets max_context:8192, recommends transformers>=5.6.0 and documents translation instructions for terminology, style, structured text and context.

sources.title: Hy-MT2 technical report, revised 25 May 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 re-read of the latest v2 report retains the 1.8B, 7B and 30B-A3B nominal sizes. Sections 2 and 2.1 describe a general Hy-series pretraining model, while Section 2.2 identifies Hy3-preview as a teacher, not the exact student checkpoint. The full report and its benchmark tables do not separately state active parameters for Hy-MT2-1.8B; that general lineage does not establish an inherited active count.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-1.8B checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: HunYuanDenseV1ForCausalLM; 32 layers, hidden size 2048, intermediate size 6144, 16 query and 4 KV heads, head dimension 128, QK normalization, vocab 120818, BF16, tie_word_embeddings:true, max_position_embeddings:262144. No quantization_config. Fresh current configuration matches this pinned revision and still requests tied word embeddings; configuration alone does not prove equality of the separately serialized weights.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-1.8B model license
sources.evidence: Explicitly licenses Hy-MT2-1.8B under Apache License Version 2.0.

sources.title: Official model repository file inventory
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 API response confirms current revision 9a341cd1b679d3efd23b46e847b01745a71ed792, one unsharded model.safetensors and no safetensors shard index. Hub automatic count remains 2038515712 BF16 storage elements; this does not independently establish a unique learned-parameter count.

sources.title: Complete bounded safetensors tensor header
sources.evidence: HTTP206 byte ranges 0-7 and 8-41359 retrieved the complete 41352-byte header only. All 355 tensor entries sum to 2038515712 BF16 elements, with no quantization scales or buffer entries. Both lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are separately stored 120818x2048 matrices; each contains 247435264 elements.

sources.title: Configured HunYuanDenseV1 model implementation, Transformers v5.6.0
sources.evidence: Tencent-copyright implementation matches the checkpoint architecture and header shapes: dense gated MLP, causal grouped-query attention, learned RMS/QK norms and embedding/output projections. Rotary inv_freq buffers are nonpersistent. Its tie mapping links lm_head.weight to model.embed_tokens.weight.

sources.title: Transformers v5.6.0 weight-tying loader behavior
sources.evidence: get_expanded_tied_weights_keys requires tie_word_embeddings; tie_weights checks equality when both stored keys exist and does not tie unequal tensors. Header shapes alone cannot establish whether the two stored matrices are equal.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Formats system, user and assistant text and a direct assistant generation prefix. It has no tools/tool-response handling or reasoning-mode switch. This documents the provided interface but does not categorically establish model-wide absence of those capabilities.

sources.title: Official training guide for the exact dense variant
sources.evidence: Explicitly labels Hy-MT2-1.8B as Dense, separately from the 30B-A3B MoE model.

sources.title: Hy-MT2 technical report version history, rechecked October 27
sources.evidence: Version history still identifies v2, revised May 25, 2026, as the latest report. No later report version supplying a separate 1.8B-model active count was available in this record.

sources.title: FlexAI Hy-MT2 1.8B deployment catalog, checked but not adopted
sources.evidence: Names the exact tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B checkpoint and displays Active parameters 2B of 2.038516B. The complete page supplies no original measurement, active-count methodology or research comparison. Its total matches the rounded serialized-element count, so 2B may likewise be a rounded storage count; this is an inference, not a documented method. This unsupported provider listing does not establish a developer or original research-team active-count convention.

sources.title: SubVision WMT26 original QLoRA study, October 2026
sources.publisher: Prajwal Ghimire and Aashish Mahato / ACL Anthology
sources.evidence: Full 16-page paper identifies exact tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B in Section 4.1 and calls it a 1.8B-parameter model. Table 1 reports 19398656 trainable / 1810479104 total parameters for its QLoRA-adapted model. Those are adaptation training counts, not a separately stated inference-active count or a proof of equality between the original checkpoint embedding/output tensors. No active-parameter column or numerical active convention appears.

sources.title: paramanandaAI WMT26 original translation adaptation study, October 2026
sources.publisher: Shiv Saud, Sundeep Dawadi and Sunil Regmi / ACL Anthology
sources.evidence: Full seven-page paper names tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B as its base. Table 1 reports 6.5M trainable adapter parameters, 0.36% of nominal 1.8B; Table 5 compares original 1.8B and 7B models. These trainable-adapter counts are not inference-active counts, and the paper supplies no active-parameter convention.

sources.title: WMT26 staged multilingual adaptation of Hy-MT2-1.8B, October 2026
sources.evidence: Full eight-page original study compares LoRA and full-parameter adaptation of Hy-MT2-1.8B. Tables 3 and 4 distinguish trainable attention adapters from all model parameters; performance and efficiency tables do not supply a numerical inference-active count.

name.note: Official spelling identifies the standard BF16 model, distinct from separately named FP8 and GGUF variants.

developer.note: The model repository, report and model-specific copyright identify Tencent.

family.note: Normalized catalog label for the explicitly named Hy-MT2 translation model family, within the broader Hy series.

release_date.note: The developer explicitly states that Hy-MT2-1.8B was open-sourced on this date. Earlier repository creation and later API-provider listing dates are not public-release evidence.

open_weights.note: Tencent publishes a downloadable unquantized BF16 checkpoint; the repository and bounded weight-file access were verified.

license.note: Model-specific license names Apache License Version 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Fresh developer card and latest technical report confirm nominal 1.8 billion parameters; retain their precision rather than replace it with storage metadata. The prior complete 355-tensor census contains 2,038,515,712 BF16 elements, including separately stored 247,435,264-element embedding and output matrices. Configuration requests tying, but the loader checks tensor equality; metadata does not prove equality, so neither the storage sum nor the deduplicated 1,791,080,448 hypothesis is asserted as the exact unique total. The later SubVision table counts its QLoRA-adapted model, not this unchanged release. No weight shards were downloaded in this re-audit.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active count was found in the freshly reopened original card, latest report, configuration or training guide, or the later original WMT26 studies. The general Hy-series pretraining relationship and Hy3-preview teacher do not establish exact base-model active lineage. Dense architecture and trainable LoRA-parameter counts do not define inference-active parameters. FlexAI lists 2B active without methodology; its 2.038516B total matches serialized storage, so the listing is insufficient to establish an original counting convention. Retain null rather than infer active=total or non-embedding parameters.

architecture.note: Official training guide explicitly calls this variant Dense. Its configured decoder-only Transformer has 32 layers, grouped-query attention, QK normalization and dense gated MLPs; no expert routing.

context_window.note: Official deployment README explicitly gives max_context:8192. The configuration has max_position_embeddings:262144, but positional capacity alone does not override the documented supported deployment context.

modalities.note: The exact checkpoint is a text causal language model with textual translation prompts and textual outputs; no image/audio encoder or multimodal input path is configured.

reasoning.note: Tencent calls the family fast-thinking and demonstrates direct translation, but these sources do not unambiguously specify a separate reasoning-mode capability or its categorical absence. The shared tokenizer vocabulary alone would not establish support; clear the unsupported baseline false.

tool_call.note: The provided template handles system/user/assistant messages and has no tool-definition or tool-response protocol. No explicit model-wide capability statement was found in the examined primary sources; clear the baseline false rather than infer categorical absence from omitted documentation.

patch.notes: Tencent reports nominal 1.8B parameters. The 2.038515712B serialized-element count includes separately stored embedding/output weights; their equality and exact unique total remain unresolved. Active parameters are not separately established. Official deployment context is 8192 tokens despite the 262144 positional configuration. Reasoning-mode and tool-calling support remain unverified.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains Tencent nominal 1.8B with primary provenance and explicitly patches active parameters to null. Current original card/config/API and latest report were reopened; three later original WMT26 studies add no inference-active convention. FlexAI 2B active is an unsupported provider listing consistent with rounded storage, not a supported replacement. Preserve the prior complete tensor census without asserting embedding/output equality or a unique exact total, and preserve all 12 other field assessments.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Nominal total 1.8B verified; active count remains undisclosed.
searches: Exact Hy-MT2-1.8B active/activated parameters and original Tencent parameter/base lineage searches.

parameter_reaudit.limitations: No complete tensor values downloaded or compared; prior header census retained. Searches did not establish a supported inference-active count. Provider storage-count rounding is a plausible explanation, not a verified methodology.
